mapper.select: SELECT target_id as houseId, COUNT(*) as viewCount FROM user_behavior WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND behavior_type = 'view' AND target_type = 'house' GROUP BY target_id ORDER BY viewCount DESC
SELECT house_id FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT DISTINCT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(behavior_data, '$.keyword')) as keyword FROM user_behavior WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND behavior_type = 'search' AND behavior_data IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALID(behavior_data) = 1 AND JSON_EXTRACT(behavior_data, '$.keyword') IS NOT NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT ub.target_id FROM user_behavior ub INNER JOIN house h ON ub.target_id = h.id WHERE ub.behavior_type IN ('view', 'favorite') AND ub.target_type = 'house' AND ub.target_id != #{houseId} AND h.status = 1 AND h.audit_status = 1 GROUP BY ub.target_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT target_id FROM user_behavior WHERE behavior_type = 'view' AND target_type = 'house' AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY target_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT house_id FROM appointment WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM user_behavior WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY user_id
